verdict.rationale: Docs state that Logfire telemetry/observability is 'built-in (but optional)' and only sends data if explicitly installed and configured, implying tracking is opt-in rather than on-by-default, but there is no explicit 'opt out' switch or privacy statement about default usage-tracking behavior. missing for 10: explicit opt-out toggle/documentation, confirmation that no telemetry is collected without Logfire, independent verification of default privacy posture.
